q: 1. Free float for any activity is defined as the difference between
options: its earliest finish time and earliest start time for its successor activity
Its latest start time and earliest start time
its latest finish time and earliest start time for successor activity
its earliest finish time and latest start time for its successor activity
explain: Free float = earliest start of the successor – earliest finish of the activity.

q: 2. Slack is
options: difference of latest allowable time and earliest expected time
explain: Slack is defined as the difference between the latest allowable time and the earliest expected time of an event.

q: 3. Critical path
explain: The critical path is always the longest path in the network.

q: 4. Negative slack occurs
options: when latest allowable time is greater than earliest expected time
when events stick to their schedule
explain: Negative slack typically arises due to deficiency of resources causing the schedule to fall behind requirements.

q: 5. The independent float affects only
explain: Independent float is the slack that affects neither predecessors nor successors, only the activity itself.

q: 6. The time by which a particular activity can be delayed without affecting the preceding and succeeding activities is known as
explain: That is the definition of independent float.

q: 7. Float is
options: the earliest time by which an activity may commence
latest time by which an activity can be delayed without hampering the completion of the project
time available-time required for an activity
explain: Float (slack) is precisely defined as the difference between latest allowable time and earliest expected time.

q: 8. For the preparation of construction schedule, the data required is
explain: Preparing a construction schedule requires data on operations, activities, and labour output - all these inputs are needed.

q: 9. Milestone chart is an improvement over
explain: Milestone charts improve on bar charts by marking key events.

q: 10. Which of the following is a type of bar chart that illustrates a project schedule?
explain: The Gantt Chart is the standard bar-chart form used to illustrate project schedules.

q: 11. The start or completion of task is called
explain: The start or completion of a task is an event.

q: 12. In construction planning, an activity is
options: an element of work which constitutes the project
Progress of work up to a stage
explain: An activity in construction planning is defined as any identifiable element of work that constitutes part of the overall project.

q: 13. An activity requires
explain: An activity needs time and resources.

q: 14. PERT
options: provides an approach for keeping planning up-to-date
provides a way for management to require that planning be done on a uniform and logical basis
permits management to foresee quickly the impact of variations from the plan
explain: All three are PERT benefits.

q: 15. PERT analysis is based upon
explain: PERT uses all three time estimates.

q: 16. Probabilistic time for completion of any activity can be found from
explain: The expected time uses all three estimates.

q: 17. The optimistic time represent the
options: shortest possible time in which an activity can be completed if everything goes exceptionally well
time in which the activity is normally expected to complete under normal contingencis
time in which an activity will take to complete in case of difficulty
explain: That is the definition of optimistic time.

q: 18. The time in which an activity will take to complete in case of difficulty, is called
explain: That is the definition of pessimistic time.

q: 19. Float or slack represent the difference between the
options: earliest completion time and latest allowable time
latest allowable time and earliest completion time
earliest completion time and normal expected time
latest allowable time and normal allowable time
explain: Float = latest allowable time – earliest completion time.

q: 20. Free float for any activity is defined as the difference between
options: its latest start time and earliest start time for its successor activity
its latest start time and earliest start time
its latest finish time and earliest start time for its successor activity
its earliest finish time and latest start time for its successor activity
explain: Free float is defined as the difference between the activity's own latest start time and its earliest start time, without delaying successor activities.

q: 21. The amount of time by which the activity completion can be delayed without interfering with the start of succeeding activity, is known as
explain: That is the definition of free float.

q: 22. The early finish time of an activity is the ……… of early start time time and duration of activity.
explain: EF = ES + duration.

q: 23. The time by which a particular activity can be delayed without affecting the proceeding and succeeding activities is known as
explain: Independent float specifically measures the delay possible in an activity without affecting either the preceding or succeeding activities.

q: 24. A Gantt chart indicates
options: balance of work to be done
comparison of actual process with the scheduled progress
explain: A Gantt chart compares actual progress with the schedule.

q: 25. The jobs going ahead of schedule are conveniently shown in
explain: Per the answer key, Gantt chart.

q: 26. Actual performance of a task is called
explain: The performance of a task is an activity.

q: 27. If the height of the frequency-distribution underneath is equal to unity, then curve is known as
explain: A standard normal distribution curve is defined such that the total area underneath the curve is equal to unity (1.0).

q: 28. The total activity slack is equal to
options: late start time - early start time
late finish time - early finish time
latest allowable event occurrence time - early finish time
explain: All three expressions give total float.

q: 29. The free float is equal to
options: latest allowable event occurrence time + early finish time
earliest event occurrence time + early finish time
latest allowable event occurrence time – early finish time
earliest event occurrence time – early finish time
explain: Free float = earliest event time of the head event – early finish time of the activity, which is option d.

q: 30. The object of technical planning is
options: initiating the procurement action of resources
explain: Technical planning covers preparing specifications, estimates, and initiating procurement of resources - all these objectives.

q: 31. The estimated time required to complete an activity is known as
explain: That is the activity duration.

q: 32. When float or slack of an activity is positive
options: it represents a situation where extra resources are available and the completion of project is not delayed
it represents that a programme falls behind schedule and additional resources are required to complete the project in time
the activity is critical and any delay in its performance will delay the completion of whole project
explain: Positive float means spare time, so the project is not delayed.

q: 33. Slack time in PERT analysis
options: can never be greater than zero
is always zero for critical activities
can never be less than zero
explain: Critical activities/events in PERT always have zero slack, as they lie directly on the critical path with no room for delay.

q: 34. Critical path method
options: makes better and detailed planning possible
provides a standard method for communication project plans, schedules time and cost performance
explain: All three are CPM benefits.

q: 35. Which of the following statement is correct?
options: When float of an activity is zero, it falls only on critical path
CPM technique is useful to minimise the direct and indirect expenses
critical path of a network represents the minimum time required for completion of project
explain: All three statements are correct.

q: 36. When float of an activity is negative
options: it represents a situation where extra resources are resources are available and the completion of project is delayed
it represents that a programme falls behind schedule and additional resources are required to complete the project in time
the activity is critical and nay delay in its performance will delay the completion of whole project
explain: Negative float means the work is behind schedule, so extra resources are needed to finish on time.

q: 37. Which of the following statement is wrong?
options: An activity consumes time and resources whereas an event do not consume time or resources
The performance of a specific task is called an activity
An event is an instantaneous point in time at which an activity begins or ends
explain: All three statements are correct, so none is wrong.

q: 38. Updating of schedule is carried out in a project
options: to assign new target date against the planned date
to reflect remedial actions for correction of deviations
explain: Schedule updating serves multiple purposes: accommodating changes, resetting target dates, and reflecting corrective actions - all of the above.

q: 39. Critical Path method (CPM) in construction management required single time estimates whereas programme evaluation and Review Technique (PERT) requires:
explain: PERT requires three (triple) time estimates - optimistic, most likely, and pessimistic - unlike CPM's single estimate.

q: 40. The constraint in case of resource smoothing operation would be
explain: Resource smoothing aims to even out resource usage without changing the project completion date, making time the primary constraint.

q: 41. In resource leveling the main constraint would be
explain: Resource leveling is performed when resource limits are fixed (constrained), which may lead to an increase in the project duration to stay within those limits.

q: 42. When the time of earliest finish and the latest finish are equal in an operation, the operation is called
explain: Zero float (EF = LF) means the activity is critical.

q: 43. A drawback of the bar chart is that
options: all the activity are independent of each other
it is difficult to judge whether an activity is completed or not
the sequence of activity is not clearly defined
explain: Per the answer key, c: bar charts do not clearly show the sequence.

q: 44. Select the incorrect statement
options: a critical path always begins at the very first event
a critical path always terminates at the last event
critical activities control the project duration
critical activity is the one for which free float is zero
explain: Per the answer key, d. Critical activities have zero total float, so the statement about free float is the incorrect one.

q: 45. Select the incorrect statements
options: its latest start time and earliest start time for its successor activity
its latest start time and earliest starts time
its latest finish time and earliest starts time for its successor activity
its earliest finish time and latest time for its successor activity
explain: The stem is missing in the scan, so only the options are shown. These options are the candidate definitions of free float (difference between…), and per the key, a is the incorrect one.

q: 46. Free float is the
explain: Free float is the part of positive total float that can be used without affecting successors.

q: 47. Critical path is
options: shortest path for the earliest completion of the project
longest path of the network from the first event to the last event
ideal path by preceding along which the project can be completed as per the schedule
the path which takes into account the completion of all the parallel activities
explain: Per the answer key, c. Standard theory says the longest path (b).

q: 48. Resource smoothening means
options: adjustment of resources to have the least variations
complete revamping of resources to suit the requirement
optimisation and economical utilisation of resources
explain: Smoothening adjusts resources to minimise variation without changing project duration.

q: 49. Construction site planning is concerned with
options: minimize the chances of wastages, deterioration and losses
maximize the safety and execution of work
explain: Effective site planning addresses progress tracking, material management to reduce waste, and safety protocols for workers.

q: 50. When all the paths are arranged according to the descending order of the float, the path which is next to critical path is known as
explain: Per the answer key, semi-critical path.
